scripts.build: npm run build -w @mission-control/shared && npm run build -w @mission-control/server && npm run build -w @mission-control/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @mission-control/shared && npm run typecheck -w @mission-control/server && npm run typecheck -w @mission-control/client && tsc -p tsconfig.json --pretty false
scripts.review:content: node scripts/check-content-baseline.mjs && node scripts/audit-editorial-health.mjs && node --test scripts/audit-editorial-health.test.mjs
scripts.drill:resilience: npm run test -w @mission-control/server -- src/test/reliability.test.ts src/test/apod.test.ts src/test/contract-fixtures.test.ts
scripts.release:preflight: npm run lockfile:check && npm run release:check && npm run release:workflow-check && npm run reliability:check && npm run drill:resilience && npm run review:missions && npm run review:content && npm run build && npm run performance:budget && npm run offline:verify
